content.short: PicPay is one of Brazil's largest digital wallets and financial super apps, with payments and credit.
content.description: PicPay is one of Brazil's largest digital wallets and financial super apps, serving tens of millions of users with payments, banking and social money features. Through the app, people hold a digital account, pay with a card, send money to friends, use Pix, pay bills, shop, and access credit, savings and crypto trading, while merchants accept payments and run promotions. PicPay blends everyday financial services with a social, cashback-driven experience that helped make peer-to-peer payments popular in Brazil. By combining wallet, account, cards, credit and merchant tools at scale, it competes with banks and other Brazilian fintechs to be a primary financial app for consumers and small businesses.
